    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    T = int(input[0])
    index = 1
    results = []
    for _ in range(T):
        A = input[index]
        B = input[index + 1]
        index += 2
        count = 0
        B_double = B + B
        for i in range(len(B)):
            if A == B_double[i:i+len(B)]:
                count += 1
        results.append(str(count))
    print('\n'.join(results))
